title: Weave module manifest
description: Declared by every module: authored as module.manifest.json in the module's source directory, embedded in the module binary for handshake cross-checking, and published as a signed sidecar whose distribution subset is carried in the channel manifest.

protocol.description: The single protocol integer this module speaks.

zone.description: Build zone: A = static CGO_ENABLED=0, B = UI-runtime-coupled pure Go, C = cgo/entitled.

privilege.description: Privilege the supervisor grants at spawn. Not every module is root.

session.description: Where the process lives. per-user-* means core registers a per-user launch vehicle (LaunchAgent gui/<uid>, logon task) instead of exec'ing from the daemon.

capabilities.description: Capability names the module requires; core gates launch on these.

subscribes.description: Event-bus topic patterns this module may subscribe to (exact or "<prefix>.*"). Core enforces this allow-list at Subscribe; empty means the module subscribes to nothing.

signing.description: Identity core pins when verifying the binary before exec.

artifacts.description: Stamped by CI at publish; absent in the authored source file.
